name: chrome-agent-bridge
description: Control user-approved Chrome tabs through a local MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Control approved Chrome tabs through MCP.
interface.longDescription: A local, open-source Chrome bridge for agents. It exposes a small MCP tool surface for listing tabs, navigating, taking snapshots and screenshots, clicking, and filling non-password fields.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my current Chrome tab and summarize the page.
Open a page in Chrome and verify the visible UI.
Fill the approved form fields, but do not submit.
